en.headline: Police arrest 17 more over suspected crash-for-cash claims
en.dek: Commercial crime officers said the latest round involved 63 claims worth 25 million dollars, taking the year's arrests to 55.
body: The Commercial Crime Bureau said it arrested 17 more people between 9 September and 6 October on suspicion of fraud linked to traffic-accident compensation claims.

Police said the 15 men and two women, aged 27 to 49, were claimants in 63 cases with a combined claim of about 25 million Hong Kong dollars. One of those arrested had filed 12 claims totalling about 3.64 million dollars, officers said. Documents and mobile phones were seized.

Since January, police said they had received reports of 669 suspected cases involving claims of about 137 million dollars. Officers estimated that 461 of the cases were linked to the same law firm. Four operations since February have led to 55 arrests.

Three people have been charged with offences including fraud, attempted fraud and perverting the course of justice. The other 52 have been released on bail and must report to police between mid-October and mid-November, police said.

zh.headline: 警方再拘17名懷疑交通意外索償騙徒
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科稱，最新一輪行動涉63宗索償、金額約2500萬元，今年累計拘捕55人。
body: 商業罪案調查科表示，人員於9月9日至10月6日在全港多區採取新一輪行動，以涉嫌詐騙拘捕17名交通意外民事索償申索人。
警方稱，被捕的15男2女年齡介乎27至49歲，涉嫌作出63宗索償，總額約2500萬港元。其中一人先後作出12宗索償，涉及約364萬元。行動中檢獲一批文件及手提電話。
警方指，自今年1月起接獲相關機構、保險公司及市民舉報，累計669宗懷疑個案，總索償金額約1.37億元。初步估計其中461宗與同一間律師樓有關連。自2月以來四次行動，累計拘捕55人。
警方稱，其中3人已被起訴，罪名包括欺詐、企圖欺詐及妨礙司法公正。其餘52人已獲准保釋候查，須於10月中旬至11月中旬向警方報到。
